newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Country Road shares feature in turnover.
newsitem.headline: Country Road shares feature in turnover.

text.p: Shares in upmarket homewares and apparel retailer Country Road Ltd featured high on turnover lists on Tuesday with about 15 percent of the company's issued capital traded.
The bulk of the trade was in three lines totalling 6.75 million through J.B. Were, all at a price of A$2.00 per share.

While the retailer has been the subject of takeover speculation in recent times, brokers were unsure of the identities of today's purchasers, although it was suggested that offshore interests may be involved.

"The sales are all substantially above the sales at A$1.70 yesterday. It is thought that maybe it is an overseas buyer picking up stock but that will probably unfold over the next few days," said a Sydney-based dealer.
Company executives were in a meeting and unavailable for comment on the heavy turnover.
Country Road shares closed 21 cents higher at A$1.91 on turnover of 7.9 million shares.
